runner: function audit(back,timing,reg,constants,snippets){const assert=(v,m)=>{if(!v)throw Error(m)}, rows=timing.rows.map(t=>{let b=back.rows.find(b=>b.target===t.target);assert(b&&b.locked==="YES"&&t.locked==="YES","locked provenance");return {...t,authority:{mercuryLockedCandidate:b.method,donorRequirement:t.workbookRequirements,explicitSupersession:null,policy:"Mercury timing normalization; no later explicit supersession recovered",selectedProductionMethod:null},state:"HOLD_NATIVE_AUTHORITY",productionAllowed:false}});let symbols=new Set([...constants.matchAll(/^\s*(SPECIES_\w+)\s*(?:=|,)/gm)].map(x=>x[1]));let identities=[["R0786","R0787","SPECIES_HYDREIGON_MEGA","SPECIES_HYDREIGON_REDUX_MEGA"],["R0867","R0868","SPECIES_TSAREENA_MEGA","SPECIES_TSAREENA_REDUX_MEGA"]].map(([id,rejected,target,redux])=>{let v=reg.historicalRegistry.find(x=>x.key===id);assert(v&&v.sourceConstant===target,"identity");assert(!symbols.has(target)&&symbols.has(redux),"source symbols");let evidence=snippets[0].text.join("\n").split("\n").filter(l=>l.includes(target+",")||l.includes(redux+","));assert(evidence.length===2&&evidence.every(l=>l.includes(id+"=KEEP")&&l.includes(rejected+"=REJECT")),"decision evidence");return {id,rejectedReview:rejected,donor:target,sourceConstant:null,existingDifferentRedux:redux,reviewAuthority:v.reviewAuthority,artworkStatus:v.status,exactArtworkKeys:v.exactArtworkKeys,evidence,state:"EXACT_DONOR_IDENTITY_RECOVERED_NATIVE_SYMBOL_MISSING",productionAllowed:false}});assert(rows.length===43&&rows.filter(x=>x.levelComparison==="DIFFERENT_LEVEL").length===37,"counts");return {rows,identities,summary:{timingRecords:43,differingLevels:37,matchingLevels:6,explicitSupersessionFound:0,donorIdentitiesConfirmed:2,nativeTargetSymbolsRecovered:0},branchHolds:timing.groups,kindCrossCheck:timing.kindCrossCheck,productionAllowed:false}}
limitations: Earlier balance records and later donor tables are different authority layers; no final per-route owner supersession located. No production level chosen.
Historical standard Mega KEEP and Redux REJECT evidence preserved; earlier balance discussion of Redux abilities does not establish later membership. Tsareena has artwork hold.
Original donor enum and three exact branching predicates remain unverified. Vanilla Scyther item branches are not evidence for Redux branches.
